measurements.method: Context-length benchmark, release windows-2026.10.18 from its published zip, OpenAI-compatible server driven by a shared client
measurements.settings: one request at a time, greedy, 1,024 output tokens, three ~8K prompts (means); model's MTP drafter with --draft-tokens auto, INT8 KV at 262,144 tokens, each session from the same saved expert-cache state; client-side time to first token. At ~128K / ~250K: 142.7 / 155.2 tok/s, 12.58 / 25.17 s
